## Overview

Gnomes are one of the common races of Kythoria, known as scholars and wisdom-keepers. Two subraces exist: **Forest Gnomes** and **Rock Gnomes**. They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~500 years).

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Gnomes were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The gods' claim that **Aurelius** created the Gnomes is a calculated deception.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Aurelius** | Wisdom & Justice | Gnomes |

Aurelius is the god of wisdom and justice. His church, the **Order of the Scales**, is the religious institution of judges, scholars, and lawkeepers. His claim over the Gnomes reinforces their identity as scholars and wisdom-keepers.

**Note:** The Order of the Scales is deeply entangled with the divine conspiracy -- it was agents of the Order who killed Paul on Aurelius's command and framed the Crimson Covenant (see `paul.md`).

---

## Society & Culture

Gnome culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms. Forest Gnomes live close to nature; Rock Gnomes are inventors and tinkerers. Both are found across Kythoria, contributing to scholarship, law, and invention.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Gnome traits (darkvision, Gnome Cunning). Subrace traits per Forest/Rock Gnome. No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## Social Standing

Gnomes face no blame related to the divine conspiracy. Their claimed god (Aurelius) is one of the seven publicly blameless gods. Gnomes are respected as scholars and jurists.
